description.value:
Genomes are a race of artificial humanoids created in production facilities, often lacking a soul and awaiting the attainment of one.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Genomes gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Charisma.
  • Type: Genomes are humanoids with the genome subtype.
  • Size: Genomes are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Genomes have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Genomes begin play speaking Common. Genomes with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Reborn Spirit: Genomes gain a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against Death spells and effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Sneaky: Genomes gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.
  • Technological Instinct: Genomes gain Technologist as a bonus feat and always treat Knowledge (Technology) as a class skill.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Dexterous Tail: Genomes have a long, flexible tail able to retrieve small, stowed objects as a swift action.
  • Ideal Vessel: A genome's class level is considered 1 level higher for determining the DC of class abilities.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Isolated: Genomes take a -2 penalty on all Diplomacy checks. A humanoid's starting attitude towards genomes is one step worse than normal.
